name: Yiyuan Cuimian Hougong
source:
“Out of my way, fuck off!”
“If I had a chance, if only I had some extraordinary power…”

Newly unemployed, I was daydreaming of a harem while walking down the street, when an arrogant hottie in a luxury car interrupted me. Could a hypnosis device I accidentally found on the bus be my chance to making my dreams come true?

“Carry these boxes up, hurry!”
“These boxes are as heavy as lead and you want me to carry them all up to the 7th floor by myself without a lift?”

I was working as a humble security guard in a hospital and was being ordered around by an unreasonable female boss. In my anger, I used this dark power for the first time.

“Good, you have satisfied your master. Now you need to remember my orders.” “Make sure you choose the best women carefully, I’m very picky.”

After this first taste of sweet victory, I started planning my own harem. The arrogant female doctor, the gentle big-sister-type nurse, the cute girlfriend-type nurse, the strict teacher-type nurse, and the weak MILF... were all in my grasp.

“This hypnotic device is clearly not a magical spell. I’m pretty certain it’s a technological product.” “Whether or not the person who made this had a greater purpose in mind, it's mine now.”

But will such power be completely free of side effects? Will I be able to enjoy all the benefits of my desires and get away with it, or will I be punished, paying a price for the power and losing everything?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1778320/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
「滾開，給我滾！」
「要是我有機會……要是我能得到什麼超凡的力量就好了……」

剛失業的我走在街上，一邊幻想著開後宮，一邊被一位開名車的傲慢美女打斷了思緒。我偶然在公車上撿到的催眠裝置，會不會就是實現夢想的機會？

「把這些箱子搬上去，快點！」
「這些箱子重得像鉛一樣，你還要我一個人搬到沒有電梯的七樓？」

我在醫院當個小小的警衛，卻被蠻不講理的女上司呼來喝去。憤怒之下，我第一次動用了這股黑暗力量。

「很好，你已經讓主人滿意了。現在要記住我的命令。」「仔細挑選最好的女人，我可是很挑剔的。」

初嘗勝利的甜頭後，我開始規劃自己的後宮。傲慢的女醫生、溫柔的大姐姐型護士、可愛的女友型護士、嚴厲的老師型護士，還有軟弱的熟女……全都落入我的掌控。

「這個催眠裝置顯然不是魔法。我很確定它是科技產品。」「無論製造者是否另有目的，現在它歸我了。」

然而，這種力量真的沒有任何副作用嗎？我能否盡享慾望帶來的好處而全身而退，還是會因此受到懲罰，付出代價並失去一切？
